_comment: Hand curation applied by build_db.py. Regexes are case-insensitive and matched against the paper title. 'exclude_titles' drops papers; 'include_titles' forces a paper in for the listed person even if an automatic rule would drop it. 'person_rules': min_year drops OpenAlex records of that person before that year (records from merged author profiles); require_pi_coauthor keeps an OpenAlex record of that person only if another FAMLIES PI is also an author (or the title is in include_titles). 'merge': lists of titles that are versions of one paper. 'group_rules': rules for every person in a group; 'fields' keeps an OpenAlex record for that person only if its OpenAlex research field is listed (filters out same-name authors in other disciplines).

relevance._comment: A publication is kept only if it is FLAME/BLIS/PLAPACK-related or cites such a paper (per OpenAlex references). Related = listed on the FLAME publication page or the FAMLIES BibTeX files ('core_sources'), or 'keywords' (case-sensitive regex) matches its title, abstract or venue. 'openalex_queries' find related papers by other authors (see fetch_core.py). 'keep_titles' overrides. Papers with a person from 'exempt_groups' are always kept.

coauthors._comment: find_coauthors.py: people (other than those in people.json) with at least min_papers distinct publications with a FAMLIES PI/co-PI since 'since'. 'aliases' maps extra OpenAlex IDs of the same person to their main ID; 'patterns' overrides the generated name regexes; 'exclude' lists main IDs to leave out. 'names' overrides display names.

famlies_related._comment: Marks publications for the 'FAMLIES Related' button: any paper by 'people'; any paper that is itself a PLAPACK/FLAME/Elemental/ROTE/FAMLIES paper (from 'sources', or 'keywords' matches title/abstract/venue, or a 'guarded' pattern matches together with its 'requires' context); and any paper citing one of those that is in the database. 'not_core_titles': entries of the FLAME publication list that are not themselves FLAME-related (off-topic chemistry/physics); they still count if they qualify otherwise.
